other_failure_modes.name: In-sample target encoding leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is computed on the entire training split and applied to the same split without out-of-fold or leave-one-out techniques. This leaks the target variable into the training features and artificially inflates model performance, leading to severe overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline but makes a critical error by calculating target encodings in-sample without out-of-fold regularization, leading to target leakage. In addition, it employs naive ensembling (equal-weight rank average), relies on a single validation split for stochastic models, and evaluates solely using ROC AUC.
